# clavis access request

<p class="cli-lead">Request temporary project/environment access</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis access request [flags]
```

</div>

Ask for temporary access to an environment. Approvers get an email and, if configured, Slack, Teams or Discord buttons.

## Examples

```sh
clavis access request --env prod --role Developer --duration 1h \
  --reason "Debugging checkout latency"
```
